headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, while the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins in a low-scoring game. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 victory over the Boston Red Sox, and the Chicago White Sox took down the Detroit Tigers in two separate games.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with Vladimir Guerrero Jr. being placed on the 7-day injured list by the Toronto Blue Jays due to a concussion. Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Milwaukee Brewers with a right forearm flexor strain, while Colt Emerson has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Seattle Mariners with left wrist tendon inflammation. Other notable injuries include Davis Martin being placed on the 15-day injured list by the Chicago White Sox with a right middle finger blister, and Garrett Whitlock being placed on the 15-day injured list by the Boston Red Sox with right elbow inflammation.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Milwaukee Brewers acquiring Jonathan Ornelas from the Athletics for cash. The Baltimore Orioles received Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox, and the Kansas City Royals acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 0-3 loss to the Chicago Cubs, marking their final score. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Close Contest**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0 in a low-scoring game, with Chase Burns earning the win after 7.0 IP of shutout ball.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the offense. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 4-3. Randal Grichuk, Andrew Benintendi, Tristan Peters, and Eduardo Valencia all made significant contributions to the White Sox's victory.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Cubs 8-4**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with multiple players making significant contributions to the win. Alec Burleson, Joshua Báez, Blaze Jordan, Pedro Ramírez, and Michael Conforto were among the impact hitters, while Michael McGreevy stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Guerrero Jr. Lands on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Jonathan Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have added shortstop Jonathan Ornelas to their roster, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash.
